Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made the initial mistake by incorrectly stating that Robert Menzies became Prime Minister due to the Liberal–Country Coalition’s victory in the 1949 federal election. This misunderstanding led to subsequent incorrect instructions to the WebSurfer to focus on the 1949 election as the event that caused Menzies to become Prime Minister, despite the fact that the correct event was Joseph Lyons' death in 1939. This caused the WebSurfer to repeatedly search for information related to the 1949 election, delaying the identification of the correct event (Lyons' death in 1939).
